dining.name: Mírate
dining.notes: Multi-level rooftop, Tulum-jungle candlelight; bar voted Best in California. Strong chic/date-night + birthday pick. Eastside.

dining.name: Wilde's
dining.notes: Tiny candlelit British bistro/wine bar; bakery-cafe by day. Intimate date-night; tables hard — Notify/bar seats. Eastside.

dining.name: Cafe Stella
dining.notes: Reopened after 2024 closure; slimmed menu — steak au poivre, frisée, frozen-lemon sorbet. Sunset Junction, home turf.

dining.name: Rasarumah
dining.notes: Eastside hotspot (Variety also flagged it). Confirm exact address/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Dunsmoor
dining.notes: Restored 1920s building around a huge wood-burning hearth. Eastside, on-profile for a special night.

dining.name: Yess
dining.notes: Grew out of the Yess Aquatic seafood truck. Chef Junya Yamasaki — confirm details next pass.

dining.name: Sushi Nakazawa
dining.notes: Omakase from a Jiro Ono protégé; NYC import's LA debut. Neighborhood unconfirmed.

dining.name: Hermon's
dining.notes: Refreshed chophouse from the Found Oyster team — martinis, pull-apart garlic bread, pasta vongole. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Mish
dining.notes: New-wave deli on La Brea — wood-fired bagels, shakshuka with challah, pastrami reuben on schmaltz-griddled rye.

dining.name: Asadero
dining.notes: Above-average taco stand — smoky asada from a chef who left corporate kitchens. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Amiguita
dining.notes: On the Resy Hit List; details unconfirmed — fill in cuisine/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Pasjoli
dining.notes: Refined French bistro, Chef Dave Beran (ex-Alinea). Westside — special-occasion, not walkable.

dining.name: Kassi
dining.notes: Greek-Med rooftop in Venice — mezze, lamb chops, grilled whole fish. Westside.

dining.name: San Laurel
dining.notes: Spanish-inflected dining high in the InterContinental DTLA (José Andrés group).

dining.name: Calabra
dining.notes: Mediterranean rooftop atop the Santa Monica Proper — charred flatbreads, mezze, grilled fish.

dining.name: Found Oyster
dining.notes: Tiny, buzzy seafood bar — clam cakes, chicken-fried oysters. Walk-in/bar; parent of Hermon's. Home turf.

dining.name: Bar Restaurant
dining.notes: Pink-hued, 'strange and fantastic' modern French. Intimate date-night; books up. Sunset Junction, walkable.

dining.name: Sogo Roll Bar
dining.notes: Handroll bar from the Sushi Note team — creative, high-quality fish. Counter seats. Eastside.

dining.name: Lolo Wine Bar
dining.notes: Low-key neighborhood wine bar with a great patio + shareable pasta. Walkable from home.

dining.name: Marco Polo
dining.notes: Outdoor-focused Italian — linguini vongole, gin-arugula cocktails. Patio date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Clark Street Bakery
dining.notes: Echo Park bakery — caramelized kouign-amann, Nordic breakfast platters. Daytime/casual.

dining.name: Kismet Rotisserie
dining.notes: Casual rotisserie next to Kismet — roast chicken on pita, veg sides. Easy weeknight. Eastside.

dining.name: Jeff's Table
dining.notes: Cult deli hidden behind a liquor store — pastrami, specialty turkey. Lunch. Eastside.

dining.name: Yang's Kitchen
dining.notes: Order-at-counter Taiwanese-Chinese — braised pork rice, beef scallion wraps. SGV-adjacent.

dining.name: Sonmari
dining.notes: Silver Lake handroll spot — inventive DIY rolls (gochujang eel, 'banh mi' albacore). Walkable.

dining.name: Bar Di Bello
dining.notes: Low-lit Milanese-style aperitivo bar — cutlets, branzino, antipasti. Date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Holbox
dining.notes: Game-changing Mexican seafood stall in Mercado La Paloma — aguachiles, tostadas. Michelin Bib-tier value (confirm). Walk-up.

dining.name: Quarter Sheets
dining.notes: Thick pan-style pizza + great wine list. Bib Gourmand value. Echo Park — walkable from home.

dining.name: Pizzeria Bianco
dining.notes: Chris Bianco's LA outpost (Row DTLA) — among the country's best pizza. Bib Gourmand. Confirm exact address.

dining.name: Sushi Note
dining.notes: Sushi-and-wine bar (team behind Sogo Roll Bar). Valley — a destination, not walkable.

dining.name: Santo
dining.notes: Japanese-Mexican nigiri/handrolls + sake & wine, Sunset Junction. Home turf; next to Bar Seco. (Santō)

dining.name: Bar Seco
dining.notes: Natural wine bar + small plates (CDMX/Madrid/Japan), spills onto Sunset. Walk-in/sidewalk seats. Next to Santo. (aka Seco)

dining.name: Superba
dining.notes: ARI'S ABSOLUTE FAVORITE — food + ambiance, the patio especially (also great inside). Superba Food + Bread, Lincoln Blvd. Westside — worth the drive.

dining.name: L&E Oyster Bar
dining.notes: Silver Lake oyster bar; the upstairs bar is the chill walk-in move. Home turf.

dining.name: Pijja Palace
dining.notes: Indian-Italian sports bar — pizza, pasta, cricket on the TVs. Very popular (hard rez / walk-in bar). Silver Lake, home turf.

dining.name: Night + Market Song
dining.notes: Kris Yenbamroong's fiery northern Thai on Sunset. Walk-in friendly. Home turf.

dining.name: Momed
dining.notes: Mediterranean — mezze, wraps, bowls. Atwater Village (also Beverly Hills). Eastside, easy.

dining.name: Bar Siesta
dining.notes: New Spanish tapas + all-Spanish wine bar (Heather Sperling team). On-taste wine bar, home turf.

dining.name: Atrium
dining.notes: Playful, vaguely-French cooking from Douglas Rankin in the old Malo space, Sunset Junction. New. Home turf.

dining.name: Bowery Bungalow
dining.notes: Modern Mediterranean from George Abou-Daoud in the former Sompun Thai. New, home turf.

dining.name: Frank n Franks
dining.notes: Sandwich spot from a Howlin' Ray's vet. Casual lunch, Chinatown — eastside-adjacent.

events.title: WORK presents: Pan-Pot [4 Hour Set], DOOSTAH, & Kitty Logic
events.detail: Berlin-based duo Pan-Pot bring their weighty brand of techno to LA in this special extended set.

artist_notes.name: Pan-Pot
artist_notes.note: Berlin duo Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix — Second State founders (home to Amelie Lens, Luigi Madonna, Perc); driving minimal-techno from two decades of Berghain residency.

artist_notes.name: DOOSTAH
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the 6AM/Synthetik Minds circuit — techno and minimal; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Kitty Logic
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ in the WORK/6AM orbit — techno; limited wider public footprint, included per the billing.

enrichment.curator_note: Pan-Pot doing a 4-hour set in a TBA-location LA warehouse for WORK is as good as the underground techno calendar gets here — the Second State co-founders know how to work a room across an extended set, and the RA pick is warranted. This is the one to build the 4th of July weekend around.
enrichment.description: WORK presents Berlin techno duo Pan-Pot in a special 4-hour set at a TBA Los Angeles location, afterhours from 11pm–6am; $30 before midnight (RA pick).

events.title: ABSTRACT: LOS ANGELES. feat. NEEK + DEA MAGNA + Merimell

artist_notes.name: NEEK
artist_notes.note: Southern California-based DJ/producer who blew up fast in the hard techno lane through viral social content and aggressive industrial-edged edits — organizer and resident for the Abstract LA series.

artist_notes.name: DEA MAGNA
artist_notes.note: LA-based live act — classically trained pianist who fuses hard techno and trance with her own vocals; releases on Reinier Zonneveld's Filth on Acid and Revealed. The live-singing-over-drum-machines format is her signature.

artist_notes.name: Merimell
artist_notes.note: Estonian techno pioneer and Machine Nation founder — one of the first women in her country's techno scene; releases on Killekill (Berlin) and Desolat-adjacent labels; sets lean hard, fast and uncompromising.

enrichment.curator_note: Hard techno and trance-industrial at full volume — Abstract runs a serious international circuit but this is squarely the harder-faster end that sits outside the house/groove lane. Worth flagging as a late-night option for when you want punishment over selection.
enrichment.description: Abstract brings their international hard techno brand to 1720 Arts District with resident NEEK alongside Estonian techno fixture Merimell and LA-based hard techno live act DEA MAGNA, 10pm-4am.

events.title: Dirtybird x FLOAT: Road to Campout • Rooftop Pool Party [2-8 PM]

artist_notes.name: Sacha Robotti
artist_notes.note: Italian-German-Belgian-raised Dirtybird mainstay since 2012, Slothacid founder — hypnotic, deep-bass tech house with a playful Ibiza edge.

artist_notes.name: Ardalan
artist_notes.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house from the Sunset Sound System lineage.

enrichment.curator_note: A Dirtybird road-to-Campout rooftop at Level 8 is a solid pre-4th setup — Sacha Robotti and Ardalan know exactly how to make an afternoon pool party feel like a proper set rather than background music. $30 pre is fair for a 6-hour run in the sun.
enrichment.description: Dirtybird x FLOAT 'Road to Campout' rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA with Sacha Robotti and Ardalan, 2–8pm, $30 pre.

artist_notes.name: Kayzo
artist_notes.note: LA-based producer (Hayden Capuozzo) who won Insomniac's Discovery Project in 2012 — builds sets by colliding hardstyle, dubstep, trap and rock-inflected bass music; founder of Welcome Records. Firmly the festival-bass end of the spectrum, not the house lane.

enrichment.curator_note: Kayzo is hardstyle-meets-dubstep-meets-electronic-rock — a big-room bass festival act rather than anything in the house or groove lane. Insomniac's Mutate series is the right home for it, but this isn't the night if groove and selection are what you're after.
enrichment.description: Insomniac's Mutate series at Exchange LA hosts Kayzo (Hayden Capuozzo), an LA-based genre-blender known for fusing hardstyle, dubstep, trap and electronic rock, 10pm-3am.

events.title: Ginger Root (DJ Set) at Camille's
events.venue: Camille's at The Bellwether (Los Angeles) j-pop, disco

artist_notes.name: Ginger Root
artist_notes.note: Cameron Lew's solo project out of Huntington Beach — indie soul/alt-disco/boogie and Japanese city pop influences; his recordings are meticulously crafted handmade synth-pop. This is a DJ set appearance, not a live band show — expect disco, boogie, and city-pop records rather than his own material.

enrichment.curator_note: Ginger Root doing a DJ set at Camille's is a fun oddity — his music sits in the boogie/alt-disco zone and a free DJ night lets him play his influences rather than perform. Low commitment, free entry, and a nice change of pace from the heavier club nights on the same night.
enrichment.description: Ginger Root (Cameron Lew, indie soul/alt-disco) plays a free DJ set at Camille's at The Bellwether, 8pm-2am.

events.title: Soul Source with Kobie Dozier, Roxswift, Duma, blksoap

artist_notes.name: blksoap
artist_notes.note: LA-born, Bay Area-based DJ and co-founder of Soul Source LA — eclectic underground selector moving through house, hip-hop, jazz and R&B; also founded the Textures party series and teaches in the Bay Area.

artist_notes.name: Kobie Dozier
artist_notes.note: LA/NYC saxophonist, composer and creative producer — performer and curator who has taken his 'For The People' tour across both cities; brings live musicianship energy into the DJ context.

artist_notes.name: Roxswift
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector on the Soul Source / local underground circuit; limited wider public profile, included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Duma
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the Soul Source circuit; limited wider public profile, included on billing confidence.

enrichment.curator_note: Soul Source is one of the better community-driven nights on the eastside — blksoap's selections are genuinely eclectic and the Airliner room keeps it unpretentious. The saxophonist/composer angle with Kobie Dozier adds something live bands nights sometimes lose when they go full DJ. Good $8 Friday if Zebulon is sold out.
enrichment.description: Soul Source LA's monthly party at The Airliner in Lincoln Heights, co-founded by blksoap — an eclectic, inclusive dance night moving through house, hip-hop, neo-soul and R&B, 9pm-2am.

events.title: WORK presents: Robert Hood, Disco Zombie, Ønyx, & Rubbermiro

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator, M-Plant founder — co-founder of Underground Resistance alongside Jeff Mills and Mad Mike, then reduced the form to its bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). A tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno sets; hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

artist_notes.name: Ønyx
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the city's underground techno circuit; has an RA profile and plays the same WORK/INCOGNITO-adjacent events — limited wider footprint, included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio's earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

enrichment.curator_note: Robert Hood in a TBA warehouse on July 4th is the anti-fireworks plan — stripped, relentless M-Plant minimal with a crew of actual LA heads supporting. WORK's format (address drops day-of) means the room stays self-selecting, which is exactly right for this.
enrichment.description: WORK presents Robert Hood (M-Plant, Detroit) with Disco Zombie, Ønyx and Rubbermiro at a TBA Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm.

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Eli Escobar (Day & Night)

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

events.title: Stereo Punks & Orlove By Day Present Young Franco [4th of July Pool Party]

artist_notes.name: Young Franco
artist_notes.note: Brisbane-born producer (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — ARIA-Gold-certified with 'Drop Your Love'; blends disco, funk, house and indie pop; debut LP 'It's Franky Baby' (2025). Festival-ready but with genuine groove DNA, not empty festival-tech-house.

artist_notes.name: Orlove
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/selector Orlovebynight — runs the Midnite City indie-disco party at The Moroccan Lounge; spins the electronic/indie crossover: Daft Punk, LCD Soundsystem, Soulwax, Justice edits.

artist_notes.name: Nica
artist_notes.note: DJ on the Paradisco/Kiss Kiss Bang Bang circuit; limited wider public profile — included on billing confidence. Paradisco is the regular resident series at this venue.

enrichment.curator_note: Paradisco is a solid disco-house monthly at one of LA's better dressed rooms — the KKBB checkered floor and '70s-deco setting are half the appeal. No deep headliner this edition, but it's free and the format is consistent if you want dressed-up disco without the Koreatown bottle-service clubs nearby.
enrichment.description: Paradisco monthly disco/house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (The Line Hotel, Koreatown) with Nica on the decks, 10pm-2am, free.

artist_notes.name: OKAYVAL
artist_notes.note: Colombian-born, Jacksonville-based DJ/producer — rising fast in the tech-house and hard techno crossover space; tracks on Insomniac Records; known for dark grooves and heavy basslines.

artist_notes.name: XVIRAD
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the DTLA underground techno/house circuit; appears on the TECHTONIK and local warehouse billing. Limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Silvertone (US)
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-based house DJ/producer — works across minimal tech, bass house and acid techno; active on the secret-warehouse circuit.

artist_notes.name: JACZ
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the DTLA warehouse underground circuit; included on billing confidence, limited verifiable wider profile.

enrichment.curator_note: OKAYVAL is gaining momentum in the darker tech-house/acid-techno lane — more serious than the name might suggest, and the TBA-warehouse format keeps the room right. Worth tracking if you want to catch her before the CRSSD bookings hit.
enrichment.description: TECHTONIK presents OKAYVAL's LA headline show at a TBA DTLA warehouse, with XVIRAD, Silvertone (US) and JACZ — hard-edged tech-house and acid techno, 11:45pm.

events.title: Club Cielo: Kebra, Linapary, Queenie, Dina

artist_notes.name: Linapary
artist_notes.note: Colombian DJ and producer based in Madrid — one of the rising voices in alter-perreo and guaracha; sets mix guaracha, tribal, baile funk and perreo with femme/queer politics baked in. Has played Whole Festival Berlin, Rinse France, La Machine Paris.

artist_notes.name: KEBRA
artist_notes.note: DJ/producer from CDMX/Brazil on the Club Cielo bill — Latin club and guaracha selector; limited public profile beyond this circuit.

artist_notes.name: DINABN
artist_notes.note: DJ behind the Club Cielo series at El Cid — resident curator setting the guaracha/tribal/Latin club format for the night; LA-based.

artist_notes.name: QUEENIE (US)
artist_notes.note: US-based DJ on the Club Cielo bill; limited public profile beyond this Latin club circuit.

enrichment.curator_note: Club Cielo is doing something specific — guaracha and alter-perreo through a femme and queer lens, which puts it well outside the house/techno lane but makes it genuinely singular in LA on any given night. Linapary is the one to watch; she's a legitimate force in European Latin club scenes.
enrichment.description: Club Cielo's 4th of July femme-DJ takeover at El Cid, Silver Lake — guaracha, baile funk, tribal and Latin club sounds with KEBRA (CDMX/Brazil), Linapary (Colombia/Madrid), QUEENIE (US) and DINABN, 10pm-2am.

events.title: Jayda G
events.venue: Sound Nightclub (Los Angeles) deep house, disco

artist_notes.name: Jayda G
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ (Jacinda Gulley) — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul in her selections. Tracked name.

enrichment.curator_note: Sound is a proper room for Jayda G — she thrives in longer, sweatier sets where she can pull the floor through disco into gospel-house without hitting a hard stop. This is the July 4th pick if warehouse TBAs feel like too much admin.
enrichment.description: Jayda G (Ninja Tune) headlines Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: TRIPTYKH
artist_notes.note: Dallas-based hard techno DJ and Klangkuenstler signee — Beatport's leading US purveyor of schranz; debut 'Unholy' EP hit #1 on the all-genre Beatport EP chart. The name in this lineup if you're going for schranz over selection.

artist_notes.name: DRAKK
artist_notes.note: US-based hard techno DJ/producer — active on BeatStats' hard techno top-20 list; limited wider public footprint beyond the hard techno circuit.

enrichment.curator_note: Hard techno/schranz through and through — TRIPTYKH is genuinely one of the better US acts in that lane, but this is the battering-ram end of the spectrum rather than anything in the groove or house vein. For the crowd that wants BPMs over 140 and nothing else.
enrichment.description: Trinity and WA$TED co-present DRAKK and TRIPTYKH at 1720 Warehouse — a 4th of July schranz/hard techno night, 9pm-2am, 18+.

events.title: DANI THORNE 4TH OF JULY HARD TECHNO

artist_notes.name: Dani Thorne
artist_notes.note: LA-based hard techno DJ/producer — draws from Nico Moreno, Sara Landry and Brutalismus 3000; big mainstage presence (EDC, Ultra, Lollapalooza); 600k+ social following. Her sets lean raw and industrial rather than refined European techno. More festival-scale energy than the underground end of the taste profile.

enrichment.curator_note: Dani Thorne is genuinely talented but her lane is the heavy, high-BPM end of American hard techno — the kind that goes big on mainstages rather than Berghain basements. At $8 and secret-location DTLA on the Fourth it's a low-stakes option if you want something pounding after midnight, not the refined European techno you'd usually chase.
enrichment.description: CLIMAX Events presents LA hard techno DJ Dani Thorne at a secret DTLA location, midnight July 4th, $8.

enrichment.curator_note: Divine LA and Apt4B Radio run intentional, intimate electronic nights — Apt4B is known for no-phone 'mini-fest' events in lofts and smaller spaces. artist_notes.note: Detroit-born, SF-based DJ — member of Honey Soundsystem (the queer SF collective that shaped the city's underground), resident at Chicago's Smart Bar; marathon-format specialist with a crate spanning house, Italo disco, techno and acid. artist_notes.note: Highly produced melodic bass / future-house — household name, not annotated in detail. His 'Virtual Self' alias does harder club-adjacent material but this is a DJ set at his own-branded festival.

enrichment.curator_note: Lost in Dreams is Insomniac's future-bass festival and this is very much Porter Robinson's personal sound rather than anything close to house or techno — lush melodic drops, emotional builds, big festival production. artist_notes.name: Markus Schulz
artist_notes.note: German-born, Miami-based trance institution and Coldharbour Recordings founder — weekly Global DJ Broadcast since 2002; DJ Mag Top 10 for multiple years; known for marathon open-to-close sets fusing progressive trance and house.

enrichment.curator_note: An open-to-close Markus Schulz at Avalon is exactly what it sounds like — peak euphoric trance from one of the genre's most durable names. Not the rooftop-groove taste, but if a proper marathon rather than a curated selector set is what Saturday calls for, this delivers.
enrichment.description: Trance DJ Markus Schulz plays an open-to-close set at Avalon Hollywood, 10pm Saturday.

enrichment.curator_note: Paradisco is KKBB's recurring disco night in Koreatown — no headliner listed, so residents only. Easy add if you're already nearby, but not worth reordering the Saturday around.
enrichment.description: Paradisco recurring disco and house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown, 10pm Saturday.

events.title: CLOSER presents THERMAL with Beau Didier (LA Debut)

artist_notes.name: Beau Didier
artist_notes.note: Amsterdam-based DJ (born 1999) making his LA debut — hard groove sound fusing ambient, techno and house; regular at Lofi, Radion and Club Basis in the Netherlands and BCCO/Vault Sessions-type underground events. Genuine European pedigree, very limited US exposure.

enrichment.curator_note: CLOSER's THERMAL night has been one of the more consistent TBA-format bookings in LA, and Beau Didier's debut is a real get — Amsterdam underground, hard groove techno-house, the kind of name you hear about before the bookings inflate. Worth the address chase if you're in the Saturday warehouse orbit.
enrichment.description: CLOSER presents THERMAL featuring Amsterdam DJ Beau Didier (LA debut) plus Kyrxmi, Hommes and ÖTAK at a TBA DTLA location, 11pm Saturday.

events.title: Disconic presents Junior, Kana Hishiya, John Smith with bilal

artist_notes.name: Kana Hishiya
artist_notes.note: Japanese DJ based in Los Angeles — dynamic fusion of house and techno, moving between punchy basslines, minimal, broken beats and psychedelic melodic passages; has toured US, Europe and Asia.

enrichment.curator_note: Disconic runs the same TBA-DTLA format as CLOSER and WORK — Kana Hishiya is the strongest name on this bill, a proper LA-based techno-house selector. The rest is local regulars; trust the format if you've been to a Disconic night before.
enrichment.description: Disconic collective night with Juniör, Kana Hishiya, John Smith and bilaliwood at a TBA Los Angeles location, 11pm Saturday.

events.title: The Hustle ~ First and Third Saturday Disco Party!

enrichment.curator_note: The Hustle at Gold Diggers — same format every first and third Saturday: boogie, classic disco, no headliner, short drive from Silver Lake. A recurring neighborhood pick.
enrichment.description: The Hustle recurring Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Lee Burridge
artist_notes.note: British DJ and All Day I Dream founder — invented 'organic house' (slower BPMs, hand drums, acoustic textures); his outdoor daytime format is exactly the rooftop-groove equivalent done properly.

artist_notes.name: Radio Slave
artist_notes.note: British producer/DJ Matt Edwards — Rekids co-founder; propulsive, muscular house and techno; also records as Cabin Fever and The Machine.

artist_notes.name: Justin Martin
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird co-founder out of San Francisco — melodic-but-tough house with emotional depth; also runs the What To Do... imprint.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: LA house legend since the late '80s — Sublevel Records founder; deep house, acid, tribal and classics; a foundational West Coast selector.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: DJ Colette
artist_notes.note: Chicago house vocalist and DJ, SmartBar resident — classically trained mezzo-soprano who sings over her own deep house sets; 25+ years in the scene.

artist_notes.name: Mikey Lion
artist_notes.note: San Diego-born DJ and Desert Hearts co-founder — the hippy/rave underground end of US house and techno; Desert Hearts Records launched free in 2014.

artist_notes.name: DAVI
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer David Alvarado — deep, refined house and techno on Crosstown Rebels and Naked Lunch; co-runs the Long Island Electrical Systems series.

enrichment.curator_note: Love Long Beach has assembled a genuinely deep bill — Lee Burridge's All Day I Dream format outdoors, Radio Slave, DJ Minx, DJ Colette, and Doc Martin in his own city. It's Long Beach rather than Silver Lake, but this lineup justifies the drive more than most weekend festivals.
enrichment.description: Love Long Beach Festival 2026 at Shoreline Aquatic Park — a daytime outdoor house and techno festival featuring Lee Burridge, Radio Slave, DJ Minx, Justin Martin, Doc Martin, DJ Colette, Mikey Lion, DAVI and others.

Worth building the Friday July 24 night around.

artist_notes.name: DJ Slugo
artist_notes.note: Chicago OG — Dance Mania co-founding member alongside Paul Johnson and DJ Deeon; one of the original architects of ghetto house and juke/footwork since the early 1990s. Classics include 'Chicago Music'; Daft Punk name-checked him on 'Teachers.' Active via his Longevity Tour.

enrichment.curator_note: Baile World is DJ CQUESTT's LA global-club-culture party, and landing DJ Slugo on his Longevity Tour is a serious move — he's one of the original architects of juke and ghetto house, and hearing that sound from the source in a secret DTLA room is categorically different from any festival-stage recreation of it.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Veteran LA/SF house DJ (Scott Schroer) with 25+ years in the game and three Billboard Dance #1s ('Shiny Disco Balls,' 'You're Not Alone,' 'Shine Your Love') — moved from electro-mash to deep jackin' house and nu-disco edits; Sirius XM BPM / Vessel SF regular.

enrichment.curator_note: Paradisco is the monthly disco-house night inside the Line Hotel's Koreatown bar — a fun, art-deco-kitsch room with a lit dance floor, roller-skaters, and Scotty Boy keeping it broadly accessible. More nightclub-fun than crate-digging serious, but the setting is genuinely good for it.
enrichment.description: Paradisco monthly disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (inside the Line Hotel, Koreatown), 10pm to close, with Scotty Boy.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ and Second State co-founder — hypnotic, peak-time techno; Factory 93 regular. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Charlotte de Witte
artist_notes.note: Belgian DJ, KNTXT founder — stripped, hard-hitting techno in the Berghain mold; one of the most consistently excellent techno headliners alive. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: DJ Seinfeld
artist_notes.note: Swedish-born Armand Jakobsson — lo-fi deep house and indie dance with emotional undertow; 'Love In Stereo' EP on Ninja Tune. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Mau P
artist_notes.note: Dutch DJ Maurits Colijn — crowd-moving tech-house ('Drums Please', 'Your Mind Is Dirty') at the mainstream/underground crossover. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house/tech-house producer Lukas Ruiz — polished melodic house with streaming mega-numbers; Canja Audio Culture label boss. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Chris Lorenzo
artist_notes.note: Birmingham-raised UK producer — playful, bass-heavy tech house and 4x4 with '80s sample palette. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Anetha
artist_notes.note: French techno DJ/producer, Mama Told Ya label founder — dark, hypnotic sets with a distinctly European grain; Berghain resident.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: German-Iraqi producer Alex Ridha, Boysnoize Records founder — electro-tinged techno with hip-hop DNA; co-wrote Lady Gaga's Grammy-winning 'Rain on Me'.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ Martyna Maja — industrial EBM, acid and sped-up trance blended into relentless high-speed techno; Repitch and Ninja Tune catalogue.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ Tiga Sontag, Turbo Recordings founder — sharp, ironic electro-house and techno; launched Chromeo and Gesaffelstein on his label.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Cuban-American DJ Eric Estornel, Ellum Audio founder — bridges melodic techno, house and electro with a Miami-rooted sensibility.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester-born DJ Zachary Bruce — UK garage/speed garage revivalist; co-founded ATW Records; 'BOTA' with Eliza Rose went UK #1.

artist_notes.name: Luuk van Dijk
artist_notes.note: Amsterdam DJ/producer — Hot Creations, VIVa Music and his own Dark Side Of The Sun; contemporary tech-house with old-school warmth.

artist_notes.name: Brutalismus 3000
artist_notes.note: Berlin duo Victoria Daldas and Theo Zeitner — nu-gabber, post-punk techno with hardcore and EBM edges; collab with Boys Noize on 2026 LP 'Harmony'.

enrichment.curator_note: The RA-picked day of HARD Summer packs more genuine underground credibility than the festival usually gets — Charlotte de Witte and Amelie Lens anchoring the main techno block alongside DJ Seinfeld and Mau P means you can spend the whole day at one or two stages without compromising. Bring patience for the Inglewood logistics.
enrichment.description: HARD Summer Music Festival Day 1 at Hollywood Park Grounds, a two-day outdoor festival featuring Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, DJ Seinfeld, Mau P, Vintage Culture, Tiga, and 50+ others across multiple stages.

artist_notes.name: EMBRZ
artist_notes.note: Dublin producer Jack Casey — melodic chill-house on Lane 8's This Never Happened imprint; BBC Radio 1 and SiriusXM attention; toured as support for Lane 8 and SG Lewis. Tranquil, emotional electronic, more headphones than dancefloor.

enrichment.curator_note: A rooftop set is genuinely the right format for EMBRZ — his chill-melodic house plays well in the open air at sunset but would feel thin in a proper club. The Harbor House DTLA terrace at 5pm is a low-stakes Saturday early-evening if the melodic/This Never Happened sound is your thing.
enrichment.description: EMBRZ (Dublin melodic-house, This Never Happened) plays an early-evening rooftop set at Harbor House DTLA, from 5pm.

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Isaac Carter, Harrison BDP, Lubelski

artist_notes.name: Isaac Carter
artist_notes.note: London-based house DJ and producer; runs the Ochi imprint for vocal-led deep house; championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison, Seth Troxler and Floating Points — bridges Chicago/Detroit influence with a distinctly London sensibility.

artist_notes.name: Harrison BDP
artist_notes.note: Cardiff-born producer Harrison Webber — deep house and techno inflected with lo-fi, acid and jazz-funk influences since 2015; releases on Berg Audio, E&X Records and Clone; appeared at fabric London.

artist_notes.name: Lubelski
artist_notes.note: LA producer Jake Lubell — multi-instrumentalist using analog gear and vinyl sampling across a spectrum from psychedelic disco to techno-rave; key track 'Doses' (co-produced with Fritz Carlton) is one of Desert Hearts' biggest; albums on Dirtybird; remixed by Skream and Roman Flügel.

enrichment.curator_note: Midnight Lovers bringing three distinct selectors — a fabric-championed Londoner, a Cardiff analog-head, and LA's own Lubelski — for a TBA Saturday afterhours is a solid mid-tier bill. Not a marquee name night, but the range is more interesting than a one-genre booking.
enrichment.description: Midnight Lovers presents a late-night TBA-location party with Isaac Carter, Harrison BDP and Lubelski, Saturday Aug 8, midnight.

artist_notes.name: Phantoms
artist_notes.note: LA duo Kyle Kaplan and Vinnie Pergola — indie-dance and French-touch-inflected house; debut on Republic/Casablanca; 'Just A Feeling' (ft Verite) hit US Dance Radio #1 for four weeks. Not the underground end of the spectrum but polished, melodic indie-electronic with real pop appeal.

enrichment.curator_note: Level 8's pool format is the right venue for Phantoms — they play a radio-friendly, indie-dance take on house that's better suited to splashing around in the sun than a warehouse. If you want the rooftop pool party experience over a deep selection, this is the call.
enrichment.description: Phantoms (LA indie-dance duo) play an afternoon pool party at Level 8 DTLA, from 2pm.

events.title: Moodymann and DJ Rashida Play Prince
events.detail: Doors: 8pm Show: 9pm 18+ Only

artist_notes.name: Moodymann
artist_notes.note: Kenny Dixon Jr. — Detroit house and soul icon, Mahogani Music founder; known for elusive, soulful, politically-charged sets that collapse the line between house, funk and jazz. A tracked name; this is a rare hybrid concept: a DJ celebration of Prince's catalog rather than a standard club night.

artist_notes.name: DJ Rashida
artist_notes.note: Detroit-rooted DJ and cultural tastemaker — signature fusion of hip-hop, funk, soul, dancehall and house; resident DJ for The Arsenio Hall Show; has collaborated with Erykah Badu, Kelis and Pharrell; one of Detroit's most celebrated selectors outside the pure techno lane.

enrichment.curator_note: Moodymann doing a Prince tribute — with rare Prince visuals and DJ Rashida alongside him — is the kind of idiosyncratic, only-in-Detroit-by-way-of-LA event that you don't skip on principle. The Regent is the right mid-size room for it: theatrical but not stadium-scale, which is exactly what the concept needs.
enrichment.description: Moodymann and Detroit DJ Rashida present an evening of Prince's music — DJ sets with rare Prince visuals — at The Regent Theater, DTLA, 9pm, 18+.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Puglia-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer — Berghain resident; eclectic blend of house, electro-disco and techno on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton and his own Funnuvojere imprint; a genuinely European deep-selection pick.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (Midnight Lovers crew, NTS, Dublab) — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector associated with the Midnight Lovers orbit — deep house and disco-leaning sets; limited wider public footprint.

enrichment.curator_note: Pagliara at The Bridge is a rare LA booking for a genuine Berghain insider — his sets run from Ostgut Ton techno textures into electro-disco without ever losing the thread. The Midnight Lovers crew sets the room up right. A Friday night worth moving things around for.
